rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something primordial, from an early era, or generally primitive rather than modern.

example.english: This primitive tribal culture is still very well preserved today.
example.traditional: 呢種原始部落文化到而家仲保留得好完整。
example.jyutping: nei1 zung2 jyun4 ci2 bou6 lok6 man4 faa3 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 bou2 lau4 dak1 hou2 jyun4 zing2

rows.note: Use this for a primitive-looking style, clothing, or person when the emphasis is old-fashioned or lacking sophistication.

example.english: That primitive-looking T-shirt of yours really stands out.
example.traditional: 你件老土恤衫真係幾搶眼喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gin6 lou5 tou2 seot1 saam1 zan1 hai6 gei2 coeng2 ngaan5 wo3

rows.note: Use this for primitive surroundings, facilities, or objects that are rudimentary and lacking in refinement.

example.english: The temporary dormitories at the construction site are very primitive.
example.traditional: 工地入面啲臨時宿舍好簡陋。
example.jyutping: gung1 dei6 jap6 min6 di1 lam4 si4 suk1 se3 hou2 gaan2 lau6
